Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - Guard Rete.overview: Lachlan Giles and Ariel Tabak's guard retention against passes that go around or under the legs (8 files, about 10 hours). It covers general concepts, key movements (including the 'gangorra'), north-south retention, under-the-legs retention (against stack and over-under style passes), preventing and recovering the angle (and why not to hip escape), the initial battle for control, and turning defence into offence with the K guard. The publisher lists 7 sections for your 8 files, so they aren't matched one to one.
Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - Guard Rete.for: Open guard players who get passed by toreando, leg drag, stack and over-under passes.

Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - Guard Rete.overview: The companion retention course from Lachlan Giles and Ariel Tabak, covering passes that go through the middle of your guard (knee cuts) and close-range smashing (body locks, half guard pressure). It covers framing, inside position, recovering guard against knee slices and body locks, and turning retention into sweeps and leg entanglements. The publisher listing has no per-volume breakdown.
Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - Guard Rete.for: Guard players who get crushed by knee cuts and body locks.

Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - Half Guard.overview: Lachlan Giles' half guard passing anthology (8 files, about 13 hours; the publisher lists 16 sections). It covers concepts, forcing half guard, finishing the pass (consolidation and back takes), and the main passing routes: cross knee-through, three-quarter mount, near-side knee-through and the smash pass. It then covers each bottom variation (half guard proper with the far-side underhook, the lockdown, half butterfly, switch base, defending their underhook, reverse half guard, deep half), linking positions together, and narrated rolling.
Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - Half Guard.for: No-gi passers who end up in half guard a lot.
key: Beating lockdown, half butterfly, deep half and reverse half

Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - High Perce.overview: Lachlan Giles' no-gi chokes, four volumes. Volume 1 is an overview of the positions and submissions (front headlock chokes such as the guillotine, darce and anaconda, and others). Volume 2 covers chokes from guard (entries and mechanics). Volume 3 covers options from inverted north-south and diving entries. Volume 4 covers safety, avoiding injury and concepts for defending frontal chokes.
Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - High Perce.for: No-gi grapplers who want reliable chokes and how to defend them.
